title: Capture Notification Event v1.1
description: Additive extension of v1.0 (notification-event.v1.schema.json) to accommodate archive-importer workloads (spec 03). v1.0 events continue to validate against this schema; producers stamp schema_version=1.1 only when emitting archive-related events. Further additive-in-place update (bead archiver-9xw, no version bump -- see the v1->v1.1 precedent this follows): event_type gains disc-detected/disc-ejected so the optical-ripper tender loop can announce disc lifecycle before any output exists. Because those two event types fire before a rip has produced an output_path/media_type, the top-level `required` list only lists the fields common to every event type; the `allOf` block below conditionally requires output_path+media_type for all OTHER (existing) event types, so existing event types keep their exact original requirements unchanged.

schema_version.description: Schema version. v1.0 events validate against this schema for backward compatibility; producers of archive events stamp 1.1.

source.description: Which capture or archive workload produced this event. v1.0: optical-ripper, document-scanner. v1.1 adds the archive-* sources.

event_type.description: The type of event. v1.0: disc-extraction-complete, scan-session-complete. v1.1 adds the archive-* event types, plus disc-detected/disc-ejected (bead archiver-9xw): optical-ripper lifecycle events fired by the tender loop when a disc is inserted/becomes readable and when it is ejected, respectively -- both fire before/without a rip output existing, so output_path/media_type are not required for them (see the schema's top-level `allOf` conditional).

event_id.description: Stable identifier for the event. Optional for v1.0 events (which historically did not carry one); archive-importer emits a deterministic hash so re-runs produce identical IDs (see spec 03 § 4.2).

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of event emission.

output_path.description: Absolute path on the cluster's data volume where the captured/extracted output was written. Required for every event_type except disc-detected/disc-ejected (archiver-9xw), which fire before a rip has produced any output -- see the top-level `allOf` conditional.

media_type.description: The type of media/content captured. v1.0 listed a closed enum of capture media types; v1.1 loosens this with an additional pattern branch so archive workloads can emit hierarchical archive/* media types without a schema bump per new provider. Required for every event_type except disc-detected/disc-ejected (archiver-9xw), which have no known media_type yet -- see the top-level `allOf` conditional.

metadata.description: Source-specific metadata. Capture workloads populate the original v1.0 fields; archive workloads populate the v1.1 fields. All fields are optional individually -- v1.0's source_device requirement is relaxed because archive events have no physical source device.

title.description: Media title from metadata lookup (OMDb for video, MusicBrainz for audio). Null for data discs and scans.

year.description: Release year from metadata lookup. Null when not applicable.

source_device.description: Device identifier matching the NFD label value (e.g. 'pioneer-bdr-xs07uhd', 'epson-ds-1630'). Required for capture workloads; null/absent for archive workloads.

disc_label.description: Volume label read from the disc. Null for scans/archives.

page_count.description: Number of pages in a scan session. Null for disc rips/archives.

session_id.description: Scan session identifier matching the session directory name. Null for disc rips/archives.

archive_format.description: Archive container format. v1.1 only. Null/absent for capture workloads.

item_count.description: Number of inner items the archive contains (e.g. files in a subtree). Null when not counted at this stage.

byte_size.description: Total byte size of the artifact described by this event.

origin.description: Free-form provenance string (e.g. 'Google Takeout (fixture)'). v1.1 only.

parent_event_id.description: Event ID of the archive-unpacked event that this subtree/import-complete event chains from. v1.1 only.

node_name.description: Kubernetes node name where the workload ran. Useful for debugging and auditing.

allOf.description: Every event_type except disc-detected/disc-ejected (archiver-9xw) keeps the original v1.0/v1.1 requirement that output_path and media_type be present -- additive-in-place, no loosening for existing event types.
disc-detected/disc-ejected are optical-ripper-only lifecycle events (archiver-9xw); constrain source accordingly for these two event types only.
